Subject: SOC 2 packet and next steps

Hi Logan —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap + next steps from our call:

- What we covered: Redwood inference runtime, Dedicated options, and how we handle data isolation for regulated workloads.
- Action items for FintechCo: review SOC 2 packet and confirm any technical or contractual blockers.
- Next step from our side: happy to schedule a short follow-up with security/infra to walk through any questions.

I've attached our SOC 2 packet (redacted for public distribution) and a link to the full packet in Drive if you need the signed reports.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Packet_20270611.pdf (PDF, 2.3MB)
Drive: https://drive.google.com/fintechco/Redwood_SOC2_Packet_20270611

If it helps, we can set up a 30-min call next week with our security lead to go through any items your team flags. What timing works for you?

Thanks,

Marissa Cole

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the follow-ups and sorry for the delay — we've been heads down on a quarter-end push and I only just looped in our procurement lead (cc'd). Aisha, I think you'll have questions about retention and access controls — Marissa included the packet but a quick call might be the fastest way to close our remaining items.

A few quick notes after a skim:
- Data retention: can you confirm maximum retention for customer logs and whether that is configurable per-tenant?
- Encryption at rest: looks standard; can you point me to where the key management section is in the packet?

Would you be available for a 30-minute call on Tue 22 Jun between 10-12 PT? If so, I'll send a calendar invite.
